notes.title: Converter is now 50% off, permanently!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40140457/7b38f550354c1569f1abe94449be8c5e8289d377.png[/img]

Converter has turned 1 today, and you see, when a baby turns one in Bosnia its parents do not throw cute birthday parties with clowns, balloons and neighborhood Karens gifting the baby with braided bodysuits. Little pumpkin's anniversary is celebrated with swift slaughter of the cutest lambs the parents can find, after which the lambs are impaled and roasted for hours. The circle of life.

Luckily, this has nothing to do with today's announcement. Converter has accomplished its main technical, creative, and financial goals, therefore the need to charge the full price isn't present anymore. From now on, the game's base price will be €4.99 ($5.99), half of the previous one. Thank you for your support, thank you for great reviews, suggestions and videos. Converter will continue to be updated as soon as my schedule allows it, and sometime this year I am aiming to publish a completely free story expansion with a... different perspective on 50Y-80Y. Of course, this will include new puzzles, perks, skills and achievements, as well as new zones and a couple of surprises.

Stay high-test and avoid the plant of the devil. Your inner alpha will thank you for it.

notes.title: Minor Update - January 15th
notes.content:
First update in the new 2022. Happy New Year everyone!

[list]
[*]Texture and material optimization. Removal of unnecessary features has added noticeable amount of fps while preserving the aesthetics.
[*]You know that long and sometimes annoying path towards the Tower of Mason that most players need to cross twice? Well, a new crafting spot has been added at the middle of it to allow the player to craft a shortcut and avoid going through multiple barrages of blue pills every time.
[*]Oh, and crafting spots now display level and cost with a marker-type UI instead of physical text plane facing the player.
[*]Fixed the bug with character keeping the previous playthrough's suit perk color in a new game. 
[*]UI improvements. Zone names have fancier animations, oxygen bar has lighter and more modern look. Right arm vitals hologram now looks more like a projection.
[*]Environment improvements. Dust and smoke is more intense and with adjusted colors. Soystorm clouds have more details and look more like clouds from the distance.
[*]Red pill containers don't just snap into existence anymore after 120 seconds. Now they hiss into existence along with a small smoke show.
[*]Outro girl is now a blue-eyed redhead with more natural look. Crashed pod has scratches and dirt.
[*]Some players may find a strange cave near the Art Hole. :)
[/list]

notes.title: Minor Update - December 25th
notes.content:
Happy Holidays everyone, hope you are enjoying this time of the year as much as I do, and hope you'll enjoy the newest improvements in Converter.

[list]
[*]Rocks and stones lighting behavior has been drastically improved. Fixed a couple of rocks with blocky textures
[*]Big crystals' materials have been fixed
[*]Animations improvements. Occasional animation snapping some players experienced while rapidly jumping and running down the rock platforms has been fixed. Landing and foot position in air have been improved
[*]Terrain now has fog and dust slowly crawling over the gravel and sand 
[*]Improved and unified look for save spots, perks and info objects
[*]Soy Spheres, Soy Caves, Soy Launchers and Soy Rays lighting improvements
[*]Red Pills not blowing up while colliding with certain objects has been fixed as well 
[/list]

notes.title: Medium Update - World material overhaul
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40140457/0941ce22fa05eda55fbd30e3fb97e70c038b3507.png[/img]

Whew lads, this one improved a lot. 
[list]
[*]Most world materials have been adjusted and brought to higher resolution without performance impact.
[*]Rocks are now visibly higher quality, sporting realistic blending with the rest of terrain. Surface properties have been adjusted and rocks don't have weird plastic glow while observed from distance. Soy infused rocks have realistic glowing cracks instead of previous shiny scratches. More variations of materials while synchronizing the style have made the game's aesthetics miles better.
[*]Soydoors also have new, more appropriate and sinister material.
[*]Animations have been further improved, with jumping/falling transitions completely snap-free while at lower levels of Strength.
[*]Suit will now change its stripes color according to your perk tier. Activating perks will make the stripes glow as new powers are infused into our hero. 
[*]Footstep sounds on gravel have been made less appealing to ASMR crew. New ones are less crunchy.
[*]Main menu planet is a solid 8/10 now.
[*]Fixed perk activation prompt appearing during the second part of death screen if you die and respawn at any perk location. 
[*]Foliage reaction to player looks and feels more natural now.
[/list]

notes.title: Minor Update - November 23rd
notes.content:
[list]
[*]More realistic movement. I've noticed some complaints about the character movement feeling light and without proper momentum. This has been fixed and the movement should now be more natural. The character will feel heavier with realistic acceleration and braking.
[*]Fixed the rest of the moving textures on rocks.
[*]Leaning angle while moving next to slopes has been fixed and should feel more natural as well.
[*]EDIT: Left/right idle stance animations have been added. Character will now try to seamlessly choose his stance depending on the leg his weight was on while walking/running.  
[/list]

notes.title: Converter V1.25 Addendum - Significant Performance and Environment Improvements
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40140457/c8c01c8b8fafd814acd74b5cac3af2db3a17bc94.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Not only has fog been optimized, a new option has been added to switch between Normal (suitable for weaker machines) and Volumetric (for muh $2000 game rigs) fog in Pause menu graphic settings. These changes alone have added 25% more FPS on some machines.
[*]New Soylake Material: Better looking, more menacing and more advanced with realistic refraction and improved performance. Surface flickering issue some players experienced has been fixed as well.
[*]New Crystal Look: Crystals should now look more realistic and in tune with the surrounding.
[*]UI Fixes: Perk borders are better aligned with content.
[*]Soy storm new look: Visible, volumetric, dynamic clouds with lighting instead of previous faint ones.
[*]Manual Save Point leftover light bug fix.
[*]Improved lighting and color corrections.
[*]Crafting objects with weird detection points have been fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Converter V1.25 - Planet's got some weed
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40140457/92f6df696fcf07619e8fb15665189896591c2e6b.png[/img]

Not that kind, you cheeky rascal. It's the kind of weed that grows in your garden, or on a neglected planet after three months of no major updates. Well, the V1.25 is here.

-Foliage. Planet 50Y-80Y is now the proud owner of vegetation. When you have oxygen pockets you should have some simple life I guess. Foliage isn't toxic (for now) so feel free to sprint through that glowing soy shrub without consequences.

-New sky and lighting. Adds a bit of a slight, but necessary punch to the game's visual style. A view of neighboring planet with its rings can now be enjoyed from the surface of 50Y-80Y.

-UI visual update. Less 2010 and closer to 2021.

-Holographic status on the character. What's the point of a high-tech space suit if the owner can't see if the death is near? Perk status on one hand, and oxygen level on the other.

-New dialogue lines. Just a couple of them, either to replace pointless ones or add a comment about the plant life.

-Jumping into soylakes should now look better with ripples appearing around the character.

-Optimization. UI is much faster now and the performance should be better than 1.24, even with new objects and foliage.

notes.title: Converter V1.24 - Perception Overhaul
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40140457/d58dcd28b67b33519dc5a482689380750cb06c03.jpg[/img]

I felt updatey today so behold Converter V1.24, a true game changer. Perception has been harnessed to the max, giving players the ability to spot approximate skill locations easier and start figuring out how to get them.

[list]
[*]Perception will allow you to spot skills from level 1. The distance will vary depending on your Perception level, but most players will be able to get a clearer hint of some skill locations they should come back to later. Dry Spell becomes a puzzle playground and everyone will easily spot where and what to aim for.
[*]New perks: Perceptor I and II. Extend your skill perception distance with some completionist Slav magic and 100% the game like a boss.
[*]Additional crafting spots further connect the zones by building smart shortcuts. Build them all and the whole planet becomes your b#%ch.
[*]Fixed the bug with perk HUD appearing after the first red pill orb at level 1. 
[*]Fixed the hilarious bug with character being able to die while waiting for the Tenet cinematic to start.
[*]Localization improvements and minor optimization.
[/list]

notes.title: Minor Update - July 24th
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Improvements to movement, walking/running/sprinting should feel better with slight camera sways (not one of those intrusive, nauseous shakes some games do)
[*]New perk ability: Collect red pill orbs with red pills. You've noticed that fat, juicy orb probably containing about 20 red pills, but it's unreachable? Shoot it with a red pill and get the spoils.
[*]Red pill orbs have been "balanced" so some of the perk abilities aren't almost useless. Yes, you'll now get fewer red pills unless you got one of the Collector perks. Or the secret epic perk.
[*][strike]Perception of 5 and above should give you slightly more range to spot the skills.[/strike] Screw it, all Perception levels can now see skill stripes, the distance will depend on the current Perception level. This has improved the exploration and skill searching fun by roughly 355%, while staying fair to the high Perception players.
[/list]

notes.title: Converter 1.23 - Further RPGfication with Perks
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40140457/714451be14b415fa66509293858b508505ac3258.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*]Introducing Perks, small upgrades the players can activate all over the the planet to enhance the character in different ways. Ranging from common green ones to very rare ones difficult to find, perks will increase newly included stats like the amount of red pills you get from orbs, chance of oxygen booster drops, crafting discounts, red pill fire rate and even spitting arc visibility distance.
[*]Soyospheres can now drop oxygen boosters, small orbs of oxygen that may help the players low on juice.
[*]Each Tenet will increase the total oxygen capacity by 25%.
[*]Getting perception to 5 will allow you to also see the type of skill nearby, with the usual red beams now in skill colors. As usual, the higher the Perception skill, the greater the distance you can spot the beam from.
[*]Improvements to Bosnian localization with some fixes and more appropriate wording
[*]Bug fixes and optimization
[/list]

notes.title: Minor Update June 5th - Manual Save Point
notes.content:
You asked, I sort of listened. Manual save points have been the request of a certain number of players. While speedrunners and hardcore platformer fans like the unforgiving nature of deaths in Converter, other players often needed a bit of help, mainly in the immenseness of the Dry Spell. Well, a healthy compromise have been introduced. 

[list]
[*]In the middle of the Dry Spell players can now occasionally use the Manual Save Point (MSP ingame) to ensure their respawn location after dying would be at the optimal distance from the majority of puzzles in that zone. After saving the game using MSP its cooldown time is 10 minutes if you are any level of Beta, and 5 minutes if you are any level of Alpha (because even virtual alien nature favors the strong), so plan your saves accordingly. The MSP will be shown to player upon collecting the Strength orb right after entering the Dry Spell.
[*]Mayor (non-tenet) story cutscenes now save your game as well upon completion, so you won't have to watch them again in case you die shortly after them.
[*]Aiming circular marker now works with Soyospheres as well
[*]Environment improvements and optimization
[/list]

notes.title: Minor Update June 2nd
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Visual and functional improvements to the aiming arc. Aiming should be more intuitive now as the aiming ark has a gradient fade helping the player estimate the distance easier. If that doesn't help, try the also added blazing red circle marking the impact location.
[*] Oxygen level now has percentage displayed next to the O2 bar. Some may say this was unnecessary, but try reaching an oxygen leak at 1% and tell me it didn't feel good living on the edge.
[*] Slight optimization and sand footstep particle color adjustment.
[/list]

notes.title: Converter V1.2 Addendum - Objectives, Jumping, Huge Terrain Improvements
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Getting lost in the mazes of 50Y-80Y? Objective markers are here! All players will now see their next objective (and the distance to it) while conquering the planet.
[*]Jumping system has been overhauled. Jumping animations now adapt to your progress and have different states.
[*]Massive terrain improvements for the desert area. Few would utter these words, but Dry Spell has never been a more charming place. 
[/list]

notes.title: Converter V1.2 - Streamer Friendly Edition
notes.content:
Exciting week at Funkyzeit Games. Newest visual and performance improvements, coupled with the previous small updates have moved the state of the game far enough to mark it as a new version.

[list]
[*]Converter is noticeably more CPU friendly due to optimization and reduction of the number of draw calls. Streaming performance should improve by quite a bit
[*]The game now runs on wider range of PC configurations, lowering the minimum requirements to almost ancient GPUs
[*]Soyospheres don't cause the slight camera glitches in some cases anymore and fade smoothly. Blue pills aren't sloppily trying to save dying soyospheres
[*]Wider, more realistic camera pitch will now allow players to aim lower and higher than usual
[*]UI improvements and slicker, less generic style. Added a couple of common keyboard and gamepad functionality for faster, more intuitive navigation  
[*]Trigger improvements and object movement adjustments for older PCs
[*]Towers and certain rock meshes have drastically increased details with higher-res textures
[*]Soy will now crawl into some rocks and boulders for visually more interesting and varied surrounding
[*]Pills will now leave temporary decals on most surfaces, helping the player adapt to the trajectories of pills
[*]Animation improvements, the character now leans realistically while running and turning
[*]Crafting places improvements to remove any leftover confusion about the stats and functionality
[*]Cinematic improvements
[/list]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sN1-1luunS8

notes.title: Full Controller Support is Here! Converter V1.1
notes.content:
Busy weekend at Funkyzeit Games! Converter now has full controller support!

-The game is playable with controller from start to end. Key rebinding for both keyboard/mouse and gamepad, all prompts, menus and tutorial screens will automatically switch and adapt to the current input mode
-Mayor animations improvements, our hero will now move according to controller input. Walking, jogging, running, sprinting. Improved jumping animation.
-Higher quality models and textures
-Many visual and functional UI improvements
-Minor bug fixes and optimization
